title: Awesome
text: I subscribe to a variety of Monthly/Quarterly boxes for my little one. This has to be the BEST one yet. The box comes in with six or seven different crafts modeled around one subject. Each craft is in a clear plastic envelope with items needed for that craft. The box also contains any items needed for the crafts that may be to big for the envelope or may be used for several of the projects. Just very well put together and easy to understand/teach and create.
label: positive
